_comment: SSOT map: docs/images/<key> is GENERATED from the admin-screenshot library. Source of truth = ~/project-hub/grabwp/assets/admin-screenshots (slug = <NN>-<page>.png). Run scripts/sync_docs_images.py after every library re-shoot. auto entries copy (optionally crop) library/<src>.png -> docs/images/<key>; manual entries are hand-made (wizard step crops / non-GrabWP screens), left untouched and reported by the script. Docs keys keep their historical base names (extension standardised to .png).
